definitions.explanation: An order issued by the Cabinet to implement laws, ranking below legislation but above ministerial ordinances in Japan's legal hierarchy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{政令|せいれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{施行|しこう}→施行：06581_shikou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new cabinet order was enacted.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{政令|せいれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: This regulation is established by government ordinance.

examples.japanese: {政令|せいれい}{指定|してい}{都市|とし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{権限|けんげん}→権限：10600_kengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{大都市|だいとし}→大都市：12204_daitoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: A government-designated city is a large city that holds special authority.

notes:
In Japan's legal hierarchy, a {政令|せいれい} is issued by the Cabinet (⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧) to implement or supplement existing laws. It ranks below ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧ (statute) but above {省令|しょうれい} (ministerial ordinance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政令|せいれい}{指定|してい}{都市|とし}: government-designated city (major cities like Osaka, Yokohama)
- {政令|せいれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{公布|こうふ}→公布：08394_koufu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to promulgate an ordinance
- {政令|せいれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{定|さだ}める→定める：10448_sadameru⟧: to establish by ordinance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧: law, statute (higher authority, passed by the Diet)
- {省令|しょうれい}: ministerial ordinance (lower authority, issued by a minister)
- ⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧: local ordinance (issued by local governments)
